slices.name: eval-gate
slices.business_invariant: 无冻结评测集不得发布；BLOCK 不得被静默改为 ALLOW

slices.name: compliance-gate
slices.business_invariant: 未备案服务不可上线；生成内容默认带标识；价格、退款、赔偿不得由 AI 单独承诺

slices.name: feedback-loop
slices.business_invariant: Bad Case 只能进入回归队列，不得直接改线上提示词

slices.name: metrics-dashboard
slices.business_invariant: 成功必须同时满足 validated 且非 rework；原始调用量不得作为北极星指标

slices.name: scenario-templates
slices.business_invariant: 模板创建不得跳过评测门禁或合规门禁

slices.name: billing-and-routing
slices.business_invariant: 降级必须显式标记原因；计费试算必须可解释，不得静默改价
